name: PowerDNS Authoritative
description: Registers your devices in PowerDNS Authoritative Server (4.x): an A record and a reverse (PTR) record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Netlens marks every record set it writes with a comment and only changes or removes record sets that carry it, so records made by anything else are never touched.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
